home.meta_title: Property operations software for vacation rentals · Pulse Flow
home.meta_description: Property management and property operations in one app: villas, jobs, maintenance, vendors, bills and guests. Built for short-term rental owners and managers.
home.og_title: The pulse of your rental operations
home.og_description: Property operations and property management in one shared app for vacation rental owners, managers, staff and guests.
home.og_image_alt: Pulse Flow: property operations software for short-term rental owners, managers, staff and guests
home.headline: The pulse of your rental operations
home.sub: Multilayered platform for managing rental properties, where each member of a company is on the same page.
home.proof_line: We are launching on Koh Phangan, onboarding the first teams by hand. Reviews will appear here when there are real ones.
home.alt_1: You send a job. You have no idea if anyone picked it up until you call.
home.alt_2: Receipts pile up as photos in a thread. Month-end means hunting through them.
home.alt_3: Someone leaves. Their vendor contacts and arrangements leave with their phone.
home.alt_answer: The chat is not going anywhere, and it should not. Pulse Flow picks up where the chat stops working: a job that is confirmed, a cost attached to a property, and a history that stays with the company.
home.card_villas_desc: One list for the owner, the assigned manager, and the person on site. Property details, status, map pin, stay dates, and a photo, so the whole team understands the objects assigned to them. Quick fill from an Airbnb listing link, then import Airbnb, Booking.com or Guesty calendars into Bookings.
home.card_jobs_desc: Simply add your property maintenance staff contacts and book them with a call or message. Or invite them to the app for both sides' convenience - staff will be able to accept jobs in-app.
home.card_money_desc: Watch how much maintenance costs you for a different period, filter by categories, approve bills when paid. All data is exportable for seamless integration with your budget sheets.
home.card_guests_desc: Trace all aspects of guest relations: invite regulars to book via the app at local rates, share house rules. A deposit with every deduction so no more misunderstanding.
home.lang_title: One language for the whole team
home.lang_desc: The manager writes the job in English, the cleaner reads it in Thai, the owner sees it in Hebrew. Each person sets their language once in their profile - jobs, chat, and messages arrive in their language automatically.
home.why_lead: Every role gets its own screen. Open the one that is about you.
home.audience_owner_desc: Occupancy, urgent work, and spend - without asking anyone.
home.audience_manager_desc: Run one or more companies. Build the day once; hand the shift over with its history.
home.audience_staff_desc: Your jobs on your phone. Confirm with one tap, send receipts from the site.
home.guest_note: Invited guests get their own screen too.
home.agent_lead: Chat with the agent in the app, or connect one from Settings. It works inside your live Pulse workspace: tasks, jobs, properties and bills, without handing over your database.
home.agent_li_chat: Chat with the agent inside Pulse - ask what's open, create a task or a job, mark work done.
home.agent_li1: Create a connection key in Settings, paste it into agent's shell, and disconnect it anytime.
home.agent_li2: Read who you are, the team, properties with check-in and check-out, open tasks, jobs and bills.
home.agent_li3: Create a task or a job for a teammate.
home.agent_li4: Mark a task done when the work is finished.
home.agent_li5: Owners and managers only. Staff and guests do not get this. After the trial it is part of Pro.
home.agent_cta: Chat in the app, or connect under Settings → Connect your agent.
home.agent_safety: The agent never gets the database key. It only uses that personal connection, scoped to your current company workspace.
home.agent_preview_note: Scripted preview. Does not call the live app.
home.agent_how_note: Create a connection key in the app under Settings → Connect your agent. Copy the config for your OS - npx fetches the bridge. You do not download Pulse.

home.agent_how_os_win: Windows - keep the short npx snippet. Cursor there already sees npx:

home.plan_personal_desc: Solo properties on your own list. Free forever. Hand them to a company owner later if you bring one on.
home.plan_company_desc: You have a manager, a cleaner or vendors. USD 15 / month for the company, 10 seats included, then USD 2 per extra seat. Only the owner pays.
home.plan_pro_desc: Add Pro for USD 9 / month on Personal or Company - Connect your agent AI integration.
home.plan_note: Billing is not switched on yet. Every registered account gets 3 months of full access - including Pro and Connect your agent - from the day it signs up.
home.referral_title: Invite 5 people, get a year of company features for free
home.referral_lead: Find your referral link in the profile. The free year is counted from the day billing system is supported.
home.faq_q1: My cleaners are not going to use another app.
home.faq_a1: They do not need to learn anything new. You send them a link, they open it in their browser, and it sits on their phone like any other app. No download, no account, no App Store. They see only their jobs, in their own language, and confirm with one tap. If they can read a WhatsApp message, they can use this.
home.faq_q2: My manager already has a system. Why would they switch?
home.faq_a2: They would not be switching - they would be adding one place where the jobs they already manage become visible to everyone else. The chat stays. What changes is that a job now has a confirmed status, a cost attached to it, and a record that does not disappear when someone leaves.
home.faq_q3: Everything is on Airbnb and Booking. Does this replace them?
home.faq_a3: No. Bookings stay where they are. Pulse Flow is about what happens after the booking: who cleans, what broke, what it cost, and what the guest can see. Paste an Airbnb listing link to Quick fill property details. Paste each listing's private calendar export (.ics) from Airbnb, Booking.com or Guesty into a property to import reserved nights into the Bookings calendar. Owners and managers can also connect Guesty Open API once in Settings to import listings and calendars. That does not replace those platforms' listings or checkout.
home.faq_a4: Personal is free forever. Company is USD 15 / month and includes 10 team seats; each extra seat is USD 2 / month. Pro adds USD 9 / month on Personal or Company for Connect your agent. Right now billing is not live, so every account gets 3 months of full access, including Pro, from the day it signs up.

home.close_title: The pulse of your rental operations

home.features_sub: Four aspects that are usually managed via four different tools.

home.pain_team_1: Every new hire gets briefed from zero
home.pain_team_2: Only one person knows which vendor to call
home.pain_team_3: Manager is out - the plan goes with them
home.pain_team_4: No shared view of what is happening today
home.pain_jobs_1: Job sent. No idea who took it
home.pain_jobs_2: Wrong villa - the chat buried the address
home.pain_jobs_3: Work done. No record of who or how much
home.pain_money_1: No clear maintenance cost per property
home.pain_money_2: Receipts lost in chats until month-end
home.pain_money_3: Out-of-pocket spend with no payback trail
home.pain_guests_1: Deposit disputes with no written record
home.pain_guests_2: House rules sent. Guest says they never got them
home.pain_guests_3: Returning guests message your personal number to book
home.alt_closing: Your rental operation, always on pulse
home.faq_q5: Will my guests have to do anything complicated?
home.faq_a5: No. You send them a link. They open it, read the house rules, and see their deposit balance. No download, no account, no payment through the app. Payments go directly to you - the app just keeps a record of the amount, any deductions, and the balance so both sides see the same thing.
home.faq_q6: Can a guest dispute a deposit deduction?
home.faq_a6: Every deduction is recorded in the app with a reason and a date. Both you and the guest see the same balance. There is no "I never received the rules" or "I don't remember agreeing to that" - it is all in one place, timestamped, and visible to both sides.
home.faq_q7: What if a guest wants to book again?
home.faq_a7: Returning guests can send a date request directly through the app. It goes to the owner or manager without going through your personal number or a third-party platform.
home.faq_q8: What happens when a staff member leaves?
home.faq_a8: Their job history, vendor contacts, and property notes stay in the system. Nothing walks out the door with their phone. The next person you bring in sees the same information from day one.
home.faq_q9: Can I use this for one property?
home.faq_a9: Yes. Personal is free forever for properties on your own list. Jobs, expenses and guests work without a team. When a real owner joins, invite them to take those properties into their company; you can stay as manager.
home.faq_a10: Each company and personal workspace is separate. Properties, team, guests and financials are visible only to people in that workspace. Guests see only what you share with them. A manager on several companies switches workspace in Settings; that does not mix inventories. Guesty Client ID and Client secret are encrypted; readable secrets are never stored in our databases. Calendar export links stay private to your company.
home.faq_q11: Can one manager work for more than one company?
home.faq_a11: Yes. Each company owner invites them as manager. One login keeps a seat in each company plus a personal property list. They switch the active company in Settings.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of Pulse Flow (the "Service") at app.pulseflow.site, www.pulseflow.site and related sites or apps. By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms.
terms.summary_li1: Pulse Flow is software for owners, managers, staff and invited guests. We help you coordinate property work. We do not rent properties, broker stays or act as landlord or host.
terms.summary_li2: We do not take or process rent, deposits or other stay money. Those payments stay between hosts and guests outside the app. Software plans (Company / Pro), when live on iOS, are purchased through the Apple App Store. Personal is free with no property limit; Company includes 10 seats then USD 2 per extra seat.
terms.summary_li3: Keep your login secure. You are responsible for activity under your account and for people you invite.
terms.summary_li4: Do not misuse the Service. We may suspend accounts that create risk for other users.
terms.what_body: Pulse Flow is a shared ops tool: properties, tasks, jobs, expense bills, contacts, team chat, guest stays, house guides, handoff notes, property handoff between personal and company workspaces, maintenance logs, reports, optional channel calendar sync (Airbnb, Booking.com, Guesty) and an optional AI agent. It is not a party to anyone's rental or employment relationship.
terms.what_li1: We are not a landlord, booking marketplace, escrow, bank, payment processor for stays, or employer of your staff.
terms.what_li2: Listing a property or recording a deposit in the app does not mean we rent that property or receive money for it.
terms.what_li3: Demo seats are for exploration only. Demo content is sample data you cannot edit into your own workspace, and we may reset it at any time. Use a real account for your properties and team.
terms.roles_intro: Cleaning and other job types are work labels, not separate account roles. Field teammates use the staff seat. One login can hold seats in more than one company plus a personal property list.
terms.roles_li1: Owner: company settings, properties, invites, software billing when live, and accepting property handoffs into their company.
terms.roles_li2: Manager: day-to-day ops with the owner across one or more companies. Some company settings stay with the owner. Personal properties can be handed to an owner via invite.
terms.roles_li3: Staff: assigned properties, tasks, jobs, team chat and expense bills. Optional personal property list for side clients.
terms.roles_li4: Guest: stay tools, house guide, Support with the host and deposit status. No team chat or master ops files.
terms.roles_li5: AI agent: optional helper for owners and managers only, scoped to their active workspace.
terms.money_li1: Rent, deposits and stay fees are paid outside Pulse Flow. Guests may upload a receipt and send /deposit so the host can confirm. That is a record only.
terms.money_li2: Expense bills in the app are ops records (for example staff submitting a receipt). They are not guest checkout.
terms.money_li3: Software subscriptions, when live on iOS, are purchased and managed in the Apple App Store. They are never rent or deposit money.
terms.owner_li1: You (not Pulse Flow) are responsible for agreements, licensing, pricing, collecting money, refunds, taxes and local compliance.
terms.owner_li2: Send clear quotes with off-platform payment instructions. Confirm deposits only after you receive funds. Keep guides and handoff notes accurate; protect access codes.
terms.owner_li3: Optional Airbnb, Booking.com or Guesty calendar export (.ics) links, and Guesty Open API Client ID / Client secret in company Settings, are secrets. You authorize us to pull occupancy and listing metadata into your workspace. Guests still book and pay on that channel. We do not take your Airbnb, Booking.com or Guesty login passwords. We are not affiliated with those platforms.
terms.owner_li4: Vet staff, supervise work and process guest data lawfully. Managers share ops access; company settings and some inventory controls stay with the owner. Accepting a property handoff moves those properties and related ops records into your company workspace.
terms.staff_li1: Work on assigned properties and keep status accurate. Submit expense bills with receipts when your team requires it.
terms.staff_li2: Pulse Flow is not your employer. Pay and supervision stay with the company that invited you.
terms.staff_li3: Talent directory listing is optional and can be turned off. Guest Support and deposits are for invited guests, not staff screens.
terms.staff_li4: Staff cannot create an AI agent connection key.
terms.guest_li1: Your host runs the rental and sets price, deposit rules and how you pay. Pulse Flow helps you request dates, confirm stays, view guides and chat in Support.
terms.guest_li2: Pay the host directly. Send /deposit with a receipt so they can confirm.
terms.guest_li3: Cancel from Stay home at least 3 days before check-in. Within 3 days, send /cancel in Support. Your host may cancel if a before-arrival deposit stays unpaid.
terms.guest_li4: Refunds and house rules are between you and your host. We do not hold guest funds or mediate payment disputes.
terms.agent_li1: Only owners and managers may use in-app agent chat or create a connection key for an external client.
terms.agent_li2: The agent works in your workspace under the key's scopes. It never receives your database password. Revoke a key anytime in Settings.
terms.agent_li3: You are responsible for what the agent does while the key is active. Check its work before relying on it for codes, money or guest changes.
terms.content_body: You keep ownership of data you submit. You grant us a limited license to host and process it to run and improve the Service. You are responsible for its legality and for privacy rules when inviting others.
terms.use_body: Do not reverse engineer the Service except where allowed by law, probe or disrupt systems, impersonate others, spam, upload malware, or use the Service for unlawful activity. We may remove content or suspend accounts that create risk.
terms.billing_body: Personal workspaces are free for solo use, with no limit on how many properties you add. New company workspaces may get a trial of full features while billing rolls out. When paid company plans are active, the company owner pays: USD 15 / month includes 10 team seats, then USD 2 / month for each extra seat. Pro adds USD 9 / month for Connect your agent. Managers and field staff are not billed individually. On iOS, billing runs through the Apple App Store, which handles the charge. Software fees follow App Store refund rules. Referral rewards work as described in the app.
terms.billing_founding: Founding company offer: the first 10 company workspaces we designate as founding (rental companies that create a company workspace during the public founding period announced on www.pulseflow.site) receive Company plan software access at no monthly Company fee for as long as we continue to offer the Company product to that workspace ("lifetime" means the remaining commercial life of that product for that workspace, not a promise that Pulse Flow or any feature will exist forever). Included: the Company plan features then generally sold for USD 15 / month and the 10 included seats. Not included unless we state otherwise in writing: Pro (USD 9 / month), seats beyond 10 (USD 2 / month each), and any future add-ons. The offer is non-transferable, one per company workspace, and does not create equity in Pulse Flow. If we rename, restructure or replace the Company plan, we will move founding workspaces to a successor with equal or greater core Company features at no Company monthly fee. If we discontinue the Service or the Company product entirely, founding access ends; no cash refund is owed for free access.
terms.s7_body: The Service is provided "as is". Pulse Flow helps you coordinate; it is not legal, tax or insurance advice, and it does not guarantee occupancy, staff performance, guest behaviour or payment between hosts and guests. To the fullest extent permitted by law, our aggregate liability is limited to software fees you paid us in the prior twelve months (or USD 100 if you paid none).
terms.s8_body: We may update these Terms, suspend access for breach or risk, or discontinue features. Continued use after we post a new "Last updated" date means you accept the update.
terms.s9_body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Thailand, except where mandatory local rights apply. Courts in Thailand have non-exclusive jurisdiction, subject to those rights. Pulse Flow operates primarily in Thailand; you remain responsible for local rental law wherever your property sits.
terms.contact_body: Pulse Flow operates app.pulseflow.site and www.pulseflow.site. For legal notices or questions: support@pulseflow.site. See also our Privacy Policy.
terms.channels_li1: Owners and managers may paste a private calendar export link from Airbnb, Booking.com or Guesty, or connect Guesty Open API credentials once for the company. That authorizes sync into Bookings and related property records only.
terms.channels_li2: Treat export links and Guesty Client ID / Client secret like passwords. Anyone with the link can often read the feed. Disconnect Guesty or clear a calendar link anytime in the app.
terms.channels_li3: Pulse Flow is not a booking channel. Listings, checkout and guest payments stay on Airbnb, Booking.com, Guesty or wherever you sell the stay.

privacy.meta_description: How Pulse Flow collects, uses and shares account and operations data. We do not take or process rent or deposit payments.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Pulse Flow collects, uses and shares information when you use app.pulseflow.site, www.pulseflow.site and related sites or apps (the "Service"). The Service is for owners, managers, staff and invited guests of rental properties.
privacy.summary_li1: We collect the account, operations and technical data needed to run the Service. We do not take or process rent or deposit payments.
privacy.summary_li2: We use it to sign you in, provide features, send the notifications you enable, keep the Service secure and improve it.
privacy.summary_li3: We share it with infrastructure providers, with teammates according to their role, with an AI agent you connect yourself, with Apple for App Store subscriptions once billing is enabled, and with authorities when the law requires.
privacy.summary_li4: We do not sell personal information, and we do not share it with advertisers.
privacy.collect_li1: Account data: name, email, role, organization memberships and optional profile details.
privacy.collect_li2: Operations data: properties (including photos and listing links), tasks, jobs, contacts, team chat, expense bills and receipts, reports, guest stays, house guides, property details and access information, maintenance logs, property handoff invites, optional calendar-export links from Airbnb, Booking.com or Guesty, and occupancy imported from those feeds.
privacy.collect_li3: Guest stay data: date requests, quotes, confirmed stays, deposit status, briefings, house-guide views and Support chat. A deposit is a record only. We do not collect card numbers for rent or deposits.
privacy.collect_li4: Technical data: device and browser type, IP address, app version, log events and the session cookies that keep you signed in.
privacy.collect_li5: Optional data: push notification tokens if you enable notifications, and cookies used by the public demo.
privacy.collect_li6: Agent data: if you use Connect your agent, we store a hash of your connection key, its label and scopes, and a log of the agent's activity in your workspace.
privacy.collect_li7: Subscription data: when App Store billing is enabled, we store subscription details on the organization, such as product and expiry date. Payment card details stay with Apple.
privacy.who_li1: Owners and managers can see the data in each company workspace they belong to, including staff work and bills, guest stays, Support chat and deposit records. Switching company does not expose another company's inventory.
privacy.who_li2: Staff can see their profile, assigned properties, tasks, jobs, team chat and the bills they submit. Receipt and property photos you upload are stored in cloud storage. Personal properties stay in their personal workspace until handed to a company.
privacy.who_li3: Guests can see their own stay, house guide, briefings, deposit record and Support chat with their host. Their host and the host's authorized team can see this data. Other guests cannot.
privacy.who_li4: Talent directory: if staff opt in, owners and managers searching in the app can see their listing, skills, location and reputation data.
privacy.who_li5: Invites and handoffs: when you invite someone or send a property handoff, we store the invite, email and join or accept record for the companies involved.
privacy.use_li1: Sign you in and enforce role-based access
privacy.use_li2: Provide the features you use and keep company and personal workspaces separate from each other
privacy.use_li4: Detect abuse, secure accounts and keep the Service reliable
privacy.use_li5: Improve the product using aggregated or de-identified insights
privacy.cookies_body: We use essential cookies and local storage for sign-in, language preference and demo mode. We do not use third-party advertising cookies. Blocking essential cookies may stop you from signing in.
privacy.providers_body: We use processors to run the Service: cloud hosting and content delivery (for example Vercel), database and authentication (for example Supabase), file storage for photos and receipts, email delivery, and Apple for paid subscriptions through the App Store when billing is enabled. They process data only to provide their services to us.
privacy.agent_li1: Only owners and managers can create connection keys. Staff and guests cannot.
privacy.agent_li2: We store a hash of the key, a label, its scopes and usage metadata. The full key is shown once, when you create it.
privacy.agent_li3: When the agent calls Pulse Flow, we process only the operational data its tools read or write, within your workspace and the scopes you granted. It cannot reach other companies' workspaces, take guest payments or obtain our database credentials.
privacy.agent_li4: You can revoke a key at any time in Settings. A revoked key stops working.
privacy.agent_li5: Check the agent's work before you rely on it for anything sensitive, such as access codes, money or guest changes.
privacy.agent_li6: The AI client you connect, such as your code editor or desktop assistant, processes your prompts on its own systems under its own privacy terms. Choose providers you trust.
privacy.s4_body: We keep data while your organization is active and for a reasonable period afterward for backups, dispute handling and legal compliance. We use HTTPS, encryption for Guesty API secrets, access controls and role-based views, so guests, staff and owners do not see each other's private channels by default. Readable Guesty Client ID and Client secret are never stored in our databases. No method is completely secure: use strong passwords or passkeys, limit invites, and protect your access codes, calendar export links and connection keys.
privacy.s5_li1: Update your profile and organization settings in the app.
privacy.s5_li2: Revoke agent connection keys in Settings.
privacy.s5_li3: Manage company subscriptions in the App Store (Subscriptions) once iOS billing is live.
privacy.s5_li4: To access, correct, export or delete your account or personal data, email support@pulseflow.site. We may need to verify your identity and keep limited records the law requires.
privacy.s6_body: Pulse Flow operates primarily in Thailand, where the demo launch is focused. Our providers may process data in other regions. The Service is for business and property operations and is not directed at children under 16. Do not create an account for a child under 16.
privacy.s7_body: We may update this policy and will post a new "Last updated" date. Continued use means you accept the update.
privacy.s8_body: Pulse Flow operates app.pulseflow.site and www.pulseflow.site. For privacy requests, legal notices or questions: support@pulseflow.site. See also our Terms of Service.
privacy.summary_li5: Guesty API secrets and channel calendar export links stay private to your company. Readable Guesty Client ID and Client secret are never stored in our databases.
privacy.collect_li8: Channel integration data: if an owner or manager connects Guesty, we store encrypted Guesty Open API Client ID and Client secret, sync status, and Guesty listing IDs linked to properties. We do not collect Airbnb, Booking.com or Guesty account passwords.
privacy.who_li6: Guesty Client ID and Client secret are never shown to staff, guests or other companies. Owners and managers see only connection status, not the secret again after save. Calendar export links stay inside your company workspace.
privacy.use_li6: Sync occupancy and listings you authorize from Airbnb, Booking.com or Guesty calendar feeds and Guesty Open API
privacy.channels_li1: We do not collect or store your Airbnb, Booking.com or Guesty login passwords.
privacy.channels_li2: Guesty Open API Client ID and Client secret that an owner or manager enters in Settings are encrypted before save. Our databases hold only ciphertext. Readable (plaintext) Client ID and Client secret are never stored in any database table, never shown again in the app after you save, and are not visible to staff, guests, other companies, or anyone browsing database records. Our servers decrypt them momentarily only to call Guesty on your behalf, then discard the plaintext.
privacy.channels_li3: Private calendar export (.ics) links from Airbnb, Booking.com or Guesty that you paste are treated as secrets. We use them only to fetch occupancy for your property workspace. They are not sold, not shared with advertisers, and not exposed to other companies. Only people in your company with the right role can manage those links in the app.
privacy.channels_li4: Occupancy and listing facts imported from those feeds stay in your workspace under the same role rules as other operations data.
privacy.channels_li5: You can disconnect Guesty or remove a calendar link at any time. We then stop using those credentials for new syncs.
